**AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF refreshed against the remote — three of four expiry invariants had failed**

**What**: Refreshed `docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md` (#717) against `main` @ `9e9cd36`. New cut: 66 open issues, 0 open PRs, 31 signed ADRs.

**Which invariants failed**: three of the four §1 conditions. `main` moved `3eff9af` -> `9e9cd36`; open issues 59 -> 66; the malformed-ADR count flipped from "exactly one" to ZERO (#676 closed via PR #692 repair + PR #696 test, in that order). The fourth held: `@logikas/brain` is still 404 with express as a 200 control, and `publish.yml` still has 0 runs — #435 has not moved across FOUR cuts.

**Corrections the refresh had to make, beyond the ticket's four**:
1. The previous §7 listed 13 unsigned tickets. Only SIX are unsigned now (#268 #327 #588 #631 #697 #699); nine had been signed without the document noticing. A hand-maintained blocker queue OVER-reports the blockage — an agent trusting it would have left signed work untaken.
2. §3 Route B was still described as OPEN. The census over all 31 signed ADRs now returns nothing.
3. §5 Línea 4 was built around #639, which closed. The live arc is now #702 -> #709 (closed, ADR-0032) -> #723 + #710.
4. §5 Línea 2's `#599 -> #312 -> ...` chain: #599 closed by MEASUREMENT (no role port in the tree; `VALID_OPS = ['init']`), so M5 is at zero implementation and the chain starts at #312.

**Gotcha worth keeping**: do NOT measure §3 Route A with `grep -c '^\*\*Status\*\*:'` on the draft. That returns 1 and reads as healthy. The guard counts the lines of the artefact the run WOULD write, after `transformDraft` prepends its own signature header. Reproduced in-process with `transformDraft` + `checkShippedContent({writes:[{relPath, text}]})` — note the field names are `relPath`/`text`, not `path`/`content`, and passing the wrong ones throws inside `guard.applies` instead of reporting.

**Line counts re-bucketed and proven disjoint**: instalación 10 · flujo 35 · memoria 8 · management 13 = 66, verified by a script that parses the four §5 sections, filters to live open issues, and asserts no issue appears twice and none is missing.

**Where**: `docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md`, 198 insertions / 101 deletions. `docs/**` is NOT in `governance.ignoreList`, so this counts against the 1000-line `lite` budget — 299 changed lines, well under. `brain:repo:check` clean; `test/adr-citation-resolves.e2e.test.mjs` 10/10.
